matches.rationale: Both findings 1 and 2 identify the same core mathematical error in Eq. (8)/(9): β^Tβ for a rank-one (semi-trivial) β actually has eigenvalues {||β||^2,0,0}, not the component-wise squared vector the paper presents, which is exactly the eigenvalue miscalculation GT flags as invalidating the paper's main result. Finding 2 traces the downstream consequence into Eq. (9)'s SIN-region claim, consistent with R3's allowance that the symptom may surface beyond the exact location of the edit.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Directly identifies that Eq. (8) misrepresents the eigenvalues of β^Tβ for the rank-one case, matching the GT's described eigenvalue error.
Extends the same eigenvalue miscalculation into Eq. (9) and shows it invalidates the paper's nonlocality (SIN) argument, matching GT's claim that the error invalidates the main result.
Raises a distinct, internally consistent concern about Proposition 2.1/Eq. (7) sign conventions that is unrelated to the GT's Eq. (8) eigenvalue defect.
